thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Streaming tail latency p99 breached for /v1/stream in us-west2. p99=4.2s (SLO 2.0s), p95=1.8s. Triggered at 2026-03-15T10:07:03Z. Suspect: control-plane configfetch/auth RPCs + DB auth retries. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/alerts/2348811223

maria: seeing a spike in streaming stalls, lots of backpressure metrics on inference-path. traces show long waits at auth service and config-fetch calls.

ajay: paging oncall, this looks like customer-facing slowdowns. @lee you oncall?

pagerduty-bot: Paging: @lee (oncall) — incident P1 triggered by alert streaming-tail-latency-us-west2 (p99 4.2s). Please acknowledge.

lee: acked. I'm on it. quick ask: can someone paste a couple of example request IDs and last 500ms of logs? Also which customers are hitting this?

kai: here's a short log snippet from the inference gateway for a single stalled request (request_id=req-8f3a):
```
2026-03-15T10:05:58.123Z INFO incoming request req-8f3a route=/v1/stream
2026-03-15T10:05:58.128Z DEBUG auth-client call=start req=auth-97
2026-03-15T10:05:59.501Z WARN auth-client retry attempt=3 latency=1373ms status=429
2026-03-15T10:05:59.502Z DEBUG config-fetch call=start config_key=route-timeouts
2026-03-15T10:06:02.900Z ERROR config-fetch status=504 backend=cfgstore
2026-03-15T10:06:02.901Z ERROR inference-runtime stall duration=3.78s req=req-8f3a
```

ajay: that config-fetch 504 + auth retries align with the backpressure graphs. looks like cfgstore and token-store are having transient throttles.

lee: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback to smaller model variant for streaming paths 2) increase local config cache TTL (temp) 3) open a higher-rate window for auth service calls to avoid 429s 4) disable the new rollout flag that's hitting heavy code path. who can flip those?

kai: I can flip 1 & 2 now. command to enable fallback (console API):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/route/fallback" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","model_variant":"small-v1","ttl_override_secs":300}'
```
Applying config cache TTL patch to the delivery agent:
```bash
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap delivery-agent --patch '{"data":{"config_cache_ttl":"300"}}'
```

kai: done. fallback enabled + cache TTL set to 300s. sending metrics.

lee: good. ajay can you contact cfgstore oncall and DB/auth teams? tag sam-db for DB/auth. we need quick scale or burst allowance.

ajay: @sam-db can you take a look at token-store/DB auth. logs show 4xx/5xx and retry storms. rate limits might be tripping.

sam-db: on it. scaling read replicas now and removing a restrictive token rate-limit rule for 5m window. running: `sudo /opt/db-admin/scale replicas +2` and adjusting rate-limit config. will post when done.

sam-db: scaled replicas, increased token-store rate window to 30s -> 120s burst allowance, and cleared a small backlog on the auth queue. watching metrics.

incident-bot: Update: after mitigations (fallback + TTL + DB scale + rate window), p95=1.2s, p99=2.9s (was 4.2s). error rate down from 3.8% -> 0.9%. still above SLO at p99 but improving.

maria: customer impact: largest traffic from AcmeApp and BenchCorp — both reported streaming stalls and degraded responsiveness. we should open incident-notice to affected accounts.

ajay: creating outreach thread and CS ticket: CS-4982. drafting message now.

lee: next steps: 1) keep fallback and cache TTL for 30m 2) monitor p99 for 15m windows, 3) coordinate permanent fixes with infra (cfgstore) + auth team 4) rollback problematic rollout flag if regressions continue.

kai: FYI the rollout flag was throttling config fetch paths by adding sync calls. I pushed a rollback patch in the rollout service: `rolloutctl rollback new-config-v2 --force` — rolled back at 10:35Z.

sam-db: auth queues cleared and backpressure reduced. no DB errors now. keeping extra replicas for 1 hour.

incident-bot: Current severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 pending stability (p99 still above SLO). Update incident timeline and link: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2348811223/postmortem-draft

maria: sending customer notices now. tagging CS for follow-ups.

lee: summary for handoff: mitigations applied (fallback, cache TTL, auth rate window, cfgstore scaling, rollout rollback). p99 improved to 2.9s. action owners: kai (fallback/cache), sam-db (auth/db scale), infra (cfgstore durable fixes), ajay (customer comms). Handoff to @lee_next_oncall at 10:48Z. please pick up if any regression.

pagerduty-bot: Handoff: @lee -> @lee_next_oncall scheduled. Pager duty note added: incident P2, tracking CS-4982.

lee: thanks team. leaving a concise runbook stepset in the incident doc and passing to next oncall. :white_check_mark:
